title: hello world!
content:
Hello, I've created this blog to document my design journey. Oftentimes, as designers, we showcase our final polished pieces, but it's the process in-between that gets lost in translation what truly intrigues me. The human experience behind creating something new, obsessing over the details, the constant challenges, the self-doubt, and the self-learning of new skills just to complete a project. I'd like to be transparent here, on my journey from getting to from point A to B ( work job work ). I think it'll also be a great meditative process for me to just take some time to write and reflect about my small wins to stay motivated.
Currently: I'm redesigning my portfolio ( they say the 3rd times the charm! 🍀 ), so expect case studies.
I was inspired to create this blog by Madani's Blog. I'm a fan of their work and their career trajectory so far (as a hopeful early career designer myself). Upon landing on their blog for the first time, I appreciated something I hadn't seen in a while; an honest and personal webpage. Seeing another designer navigate their early career and speaking on their experience so candidly, makes me feel less alone :).
